title: Review of c44's seasons negative on seed 5: replicated (mild seasons: no deaths; 50 t famines: synchronous shrink and regrowth), and a 70 t famine in the unscanned gap also kills no body selectively: all 6 drop below threshold together and all 6 return in place, 7 times
summary: Labkit re-runs of the finding's world.py on a new seed (5), 128x128, T=20000, season_T 2000 from t=6000: lo25 (kF x0.25 for half of each season) keeps 6 bodies throughout, 0 deaths, 2 persistent splits; p025 (kF=0 for 50 t per season) keeps 6-7 bodies before and after every famine with a dip to 2 inside famines; p035 (kF=0 for 70 t, inside the 50-100 t gap the finding did not scan) takes all 6 bodies below threshold at the end of every famine (components 0 at t=8000, 10000, ..., 20000) and all 6 regrow within ~300 t at the same places (p035/seed5/timeseries.png; counts 6 before and 6 after each of 7 famines). No selective death at any famine length tried.

observations.D: lo25/seed5/metrics.json: 6 bodies before and after every season, 0 deaths; p025: 6-7 before and after each 50 t famine; p035 (70 t): 6 -> 0 -> 6 at every famine, the same sites (p035/seed5/timeseries.png), so seasons give no selective deaths and no continued births

controls_run.D: lo25/, p025/ and p035/ arms on seed 5; the no-season world is the finding's control

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and one period (2000 t); body counts from labkit at 100 t frames, so the minimum inside a famine is sampled coarsely; I did not scan famines of 80-100 t, where c40's 100 t fork kills every body, so a narrow window of partial death may still exist there.
